    StartersCleopatra Club toastiesBologna and cheese on griddled white. Ask for KatherineHow to make it8 slices of white bread20g yellow mustard120g devon80g American-style cheese slices30g butter, softenedSpread the bread with mustard and layer devon and cheese between the slices to make sandwiches.Butter the outsides.Griddle under a weighted pan until crisp and the cheese melts, turning once. Work in batches.Cut into fingers to share.LA street tacosMarinated beef grilled and chopped, warm corn tortillas, onion, coriander, salsa verde and limeHow to make it500g skirt steak4 limes2 garlic cloves1 tsp ground cumin12 small corn tortillas1 white onion1 small bunch coriander150g salsa verdeMarinate the steak in lime juice, crushed garlic and cumin.Grill hot on both sides.Rest the steak, then chop small.Warm the tortillas and dice the onion.Fill the tortillas with steak, onion, coriander and salsa verde, with lime wedges on the side.Hot lineTango's tailored rib eyeDry-brined, seared hard and basted with thyme butter, pulled at medium rareHow to make it4 rib eye steaks (about 200g each)1 tsp fine salt1 tbsp neutral oil50g butter4 sprigs of thyme3 garlic clovesPat the steaks dry, season with salt and refrigerate uncovered to dry-brine.Heat a heavy pan with oil until hot and sear the steaks hard on both sides, in batches.Lower the heat, add the butter, thyme and crushed garlic and baste. Take out at 54°C in the centre for medium rare.Rest the steaks, slice and spoon over the pan butter.Breakout glazed meatloaf and mashBeef and pork loaf, sticky tomato and brown sugar glaze, buttery mash and minted peasHow to make itNot on tonight's cookBeef and pork meatloaf with a sticky tomato and brown sugar glaze, thick slices on buttery mash with minted peas.Mix 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 60g breadcrumbs, 1 egg, 2 tbsp Worcestershire and salt.Shape into a loaf in a lined tin.Mix 80ml tomato sauce with 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp vinegar, spread over and bake at 180°C for 60 minutes.Boil 1kg potatoes, mash with 60g butter and 100ml hot milk.Cook 300g frozen peas 3 minutes and toss with butter and mint.Rest the loaf 10 minutes before slicing.SweetsKiki's cupcakesFor Kiki.
